rate_limits: Default limits are 200 REST API requests per minute per organization and 50 per minute per authenticated user; both apply, and plan-specific limits may vary. Responses include organization and user RateLimit headers; exceeding either returns HTTP 429.
resolution_notes: rate_limits: ORIGINAL is incorrect. Current official docs specify 200 requests/minute per organization plus a 50 requests/minute per-user default, with both enforced and HTTP 429 on exceed. Evidence: https://buildkite.com/docs/apis/rest-api/rate-limits and https://buildkite.com/docs/platform/limits
